reason: Glint could not reproduce the bug with an automated test (The test passed on the buggy app, so it does not reproduce the bug).

spec.summary: Editing and saving a todo item duplicates it in the list and increments the remaining item count.
steps: Type "clean desk" into the "What needs to be done?" input and press Enter.
Click the checkbox next to "clean desk" to mark it as completed.
Type "fix bug" into the "What needs to be done?" input and press Enter.
Double-click on "fix bug" to enter edit mode.
Press Enter to save the edit to "fix bug".
spec.expected: The list should contain two items: "clean desk" (completed) and a single "fix bug" (active), and the footer should display "1 item left".
spec.observed: The list contains three items: "clean desk" (completed) and two separate "fix bug" items (both active), and the footer displays "2 items left".
evidence_notes: "fix bug" is in edit mode with "1 item left" shown in the footer.
After finishing the edit, two "fix bug" items appear in the list and the footer shows "2 items left".
After adding "buy milk", both duplicate "fix bug" items remain in the list and the footer shows "3 items left".

gates.detail: The test passed on the buggy app, so it does not reproduce the bug.
